requirement_coverage.R06: Manual/event requests coalesce with a guarded scheduled poll at the same immutable goal UTC slot; concurrent retry and restart retain one intent, cycle, context and outbox start.
requirement_coverage.R07: Cutover polling invokes ordinary G0 admission after the durable schedule batch; a committed unadmitted intent is recovered on later poll without a second cycle.
requirement_coverage.R08: One active V2 goal revision and same-program dry-run legacy fixture schedule bind to a future aligned first-V4 slot. Pause/readback precedes cursor activation; opt-in independent bounded polling skips pending, stopped, stale or rolled-back cutovers.
requirement_coverage.R13: Signed URL-scoped prepare/inspect/activate/poll/rollback requires separate current cycles:schedule and cycles:write grants; a genuine non-owner role succeeds without authority edit privilege.
requirement_coverage.R18: Current goal/workspace stop holds fixture activation, polling and legacy resume. A rollback_pending row fences V4 polling before any external resume.
requirement_coverage.R53: Fixture public API, CLI and SDK share exact cutover idempotency keys and redacted scoped reads; no route directly starts or signals Temporal.
